Which Ghost of Yotei Mode Should You Play?
Ghost of Yotei offers three distinct experiences inspired by Japanese auteurs: Kurosawa Mode delivers sweeping, cinematic battles and a methodical pace.
Miike Mode cranks up the intensity with unpredictable encounters and pulse-racing action.
Watanabe Mode blends slick style, smart dialogue, and quirky side missions for a laid-back, character-driven ride.
